confirmed_mismatch: Reward eligibility omits wheels for pure side/yaw commands while frozen evaluation requires repeated lifts on all four wheels.
gate_requirement: For each pure vy/wz direction, >=3/6 trials must survive and each of four wheels must have >=2 qualifying lifts.

evidence.reward_code: source/stages/swing_reward.py: eligible=(params[eligible]>0)&active; rewards and overdue only apply to eligible wheels

interpretation: Omitted wheels receive neither swing-event credit nor the per-wheel overdue penalty.
This is a missing training incentive, not a proof that all-four stepping is physically impossible.
Existing survival, tracking, joint regularization and contact terms may still move these wheels indirectly.
Saturation and this mismatch are independently observed. Their relative causal contribution is not yet isolated.
required_followup: Do not loosen the all-four-wheel acceptance test to match defective baseline events.
Build a separately versioned reward calibration giving every wheel an active contact-event criterion in pure vy/wz modes.
Use mirrored left/right parameter sets; do not copy an anchored wheel as desired behavior.
Keep vx-only rolling and zero-command standing outside stepping-event and overdue rewards.
Freeze all other changes for an eligibility-only ablation, then compare paired joint angles, supports, tracking and high-frequency behavior.
Handle inherited actor saturation in a separate controlled ablation; reduced exploration std alone has not fixed it.
current_run_policy: Keep base 10000 and the planned 3x600 stages unchanged for the authorized comparison; preserve failures and mark unqualified models research_only.
